text.description_html:
Omnia AP-8190/300-US32D, 15-3/4 Inch Modern Square Appliance Handle

This 15 Inch Modern Square Stainless Steel Appliance Handle has a brushed stainless steel finish for a look that is very now. It has 11-13/16 inch mounting holes and a 3-9/16 inch projection. It has a 1-1/8 inch grip, so it is sturdy. This Modern Appliance Handle can be used all over the kitchen including on refrigerators and ovens.

Also available: Matching longer 23-5/8" Modern Square Appliance Handle

Specifications for the Omnia AP-8190/300-US32D Square Appliance Handle:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center Mount Holes: 11-13/16"
  • Overall Length: 15-3/4"
  • Projection: 3-9/16"
  • Clearance: 2-7/16"
  • Handle Length: 1-1/8" square
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold Individually
